key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:4B1A
name: clip_cell_rect_for_draw
description: Looks up the bounds of a cell in two tables and clamps the rectangle to the fixed limits of 0 to 19 and 0 to 199. When the flag argument is nonzero, it sets up five row addresses and passes them with a stride and width to a library routine, linking the request into a list.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:50A4
name: walk_width_scaled_strips
description: Stores the first bounds pair, then walks the second range in strips whose length comes from a fixed quotient of 812 divided by the row width. Each strip is clamped to the end of the range, and two routines run per strip until the range is exhausted.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:5138
name: shuffle_and_mask_buffer_passes
description: Shuffles a 16-entry word table with a random-number library call, then runs 16 passes that AND each buffer word with a rotating window of that table. It calls a routine after every pass and restores a saved field before a final call.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:51D2
name: apply_rotating_mask_rows
description: Continues the rotating table mask across buffer words, advancing through rows and passes. At the end of each row it calls a routine, and after the last pass it clears a flag, restores a saved value and returns.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:5250
name: stub_empty_return
description: The body is a bare return with no work, so calling it has no effect. It is a no-op stub.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:5258
name: wait_port_until_code_104
description: Loops on a message port: it waits for a message, reads that message's code field, and replies to it. It repeats until the code equals 104, with the port and message calls made through library vectors in the data area.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:5262
name: poll_port_until_flag_set
description: Waits on a message port in a loop, reading and replying to each message. It sets a flag cell to nonzero once a message with code 104 arrives, and the loop ends when that flag is set.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:538A
name: open_graphics_and_intuition_libs
description: Opens the graphics and intuition libraries by name and stores each handle. If an open fails, it calls the error routine with the message text, and if the second open fails it closes the first library before reporting.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:543E
name: open_screen_and_window
description: Opens a screen from its setup structure and then a window on it, closing the screen and calling the error routine with the message text if the window cannot be opened. It then saves the window's message port and a related structure pointer and performs a fixed-size allocation step.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:5538
name: transfer_32_byte_block_arg
description: Calls a library I/O routine with a stored handle, the caller's pointer argument, and a length of 32.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:5554
name: transfer_global_32_byte_block
description: Calls the same library I/O routine with a stored handle, a fixed buffer in the data area, and a length of 32.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:5570
name: close_window_and_screen
description: Closes the window handle saved when it was opened, then closes the screen handle saved with it.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:558C
name: close_both_library_handles
description: Closes the two library handles saved when the libraries were opened earlier, one after the other.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:55A8
name: write_decimal_into_buffer
description: Writes a number as decimal characters into a buffer. A zero value is written as a single zero character, and other values are converted by a library helper and written digit by digit through a recursive call.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:55BC
name: append_decimal_at_cursor
description: Converts a value to decimal text through the recursive digit writer, writes the final digit at the buffer cursor stored in a structure field, and advances that cursor by one.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:55F6
name: build_flagged_cell_index_tables
description: Scans 64 flag bytes and, for each set flag, records its index in two lookup tables and calls a routine with a value from a row-pointer table. The row pointer advances every eight cells.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:569A
name: interpolate_point_between_endpoints
description: Computes an x and y position a fraction of the way from a start point to an end point, using a scale pair and round-to-nearest division. It stores both coordinates in the destination cells.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:5726
name: interpolate_point_from_record
description: Computes an x and y position from a base point and delta fields in a structure, each scaled by a stored factor and rounded to the nearest value. It stores both coordinates in global cells.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:577A
name: compute_rounded_y_offset
description: Computes only the y coordinate with the same rounded scaling as the neighbouring interpolation routine. The result is stored in a global cell.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:57A8
name: enqueue_typed_record_in_ring
description: Stores a record of the given type in one of 32 ring slots and links it into a chain keyed by type. It fills the record's fields and calls two routines when a type-3 record has differing values.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:57DE
name: store_state_and_enqueue_record
description: Sets a state cell from a lookup table, advances a 32-slot ring index, and fills the new record with the kind, value and context fields. It links the record into a chain keyed by its first argument, and when the kind is 3 with a differing value it calls two routines.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:57F4
name: mark_flag_and_enqueue_record
description: Sets a flag cell chosen from a lookup table unless the kind is 8, then stores a record in the next ring slot and links it into a chain. When the kind is 3 with a differing value, it calls two routines.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:5856
name: append_record_to_chain_tail
description: Walks a chain to its last entry, links the next ring slot onto that tail, and fills in the record fields. It calls two routines when the kind is 3 and the value differs.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:5872
name: append_record_to_indexed_chain
description: Links the next ring slot onto the chain whose head is selected by the first argument, then fills in the record fields. It calls two routines when the kind is 3 and the value differs.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:58DC
name: forward_call_and_return
description: Calls one other routine with no arguments and returns, so it only forwards the call.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:58F2
name: store_record_and_update_flag
description: Advances the ring index and writes a record from two arguments into the new slot, saving that slot index in a cell. It then sets a flag from a lookup table, using one rule for kind 5 and another for kinds other than 8.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:596A
name: set_state_from_lookup_table
description: Looks up a byte in a table by the argument and keeps its low three bits in a state cell. It returns the value of a status cell.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:5980
name: set_flag_unless_eight
description: Sets one flag byte chosen by a table value minus one, unless the first argument equals 8. It returns a status cell.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:59B6
name: activate_and_build_record_node
description: Marks a record active from its table entry, allocates a node and fills its fields from table data. A switch on the record's kind selects one of several setup paths, each making library vector calls.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:611A
name: append_node_to_global_list
description: Appends a node to the end of the list whose head is held in a global cell, setting the head when the list is empty. It clears the new node's link and returns the previous head.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:6134
name: append_node_to_tail
description: Walks to the last node of a chain, makes the given node its successor, and clears that node's link.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:6140
name: link_pointer_chain
description: Stores a pointer into the link field of one node and clears the link field of the new node, joining the two nodes into a chain.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:6150
name: unlink_node_from_global_list
description: Finds a node in the list rooted at a global cell, replaces its predecessor's link with the node's successor, and then calls a routine with the removed node.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:6186
name: process_active_node_list
description: Walks the active node list and calls a handler chosen by each node's kind code. When a handler reports completion, it clears the matching flag and removes the node, returning 1 if the list was empty and 0 otherwise.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:6290
name: run_node_sequence_if_ready
description: Calls a per-node routine and, when it succeeds, starts that node's sequence. It then loads two output words from lookup tables and returns the status.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:62B2
name: start_node_sequence_from_table
description: When the sequence length is still unknown and the mode flag is clear, it counts the table entries up to the end marker 65535 and stores the count. It then points the node at its sequence entry, calls a routine with the entry's offsets, and returns zero.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:62E0
name: count_and_start_node_sequence
description: Counts the entries of a node's sequence up to the end marker and stores the length. It then sets the sequence pointer, marks the node started, calls a routine with the table offsets, and returns zero.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:6306
name: start_fixed_length_node_sequence
description: Sets a node's sequence length to 8 and marks it started. It computes the sequence pointer from the table entry, calls a routine with the offsets, and returns zero.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:6326
name: start_node_sequence_from_pointer
description: Advances the sequence pointer to the next table entry and calculates the node's offsets from it. It calls a routine with the result and returns zero.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:638E
name: step_node_sequence_frame
description: While the node's frame index is below its sequence length, it reads the next entry, calls two routines with coordinates from lookup tables, and advances the index. Otherwise it returns a finished status.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:63C8
name: advance_timed_sequence_step
description: Advances a step counter and calls two routines with coordinates from table lookups. It then sets a pending flag and updates the sequence pointer.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:648E
name: set_status_and_store_pointer
description: Sets a status word to 1, stores the record's pointer into the destination, and returns zero.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:6712
name: run_setup_screen_strings
description: Sets up the display and loads a table of text string pointers ending in a sentinel. The table includes the labels Black and White, and the routine then runs its drawing and input calls over these strings.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:6A04
name: begin_sequence_after_gate_check
description: Clears a global cell and calls a gate routine, returning zero if the gate fails. Otherwise it copies two config words into the node, counts the table entries up to the end marker, halves the count unless the mode flag is set, and starts the sequence with a routine call.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:6A34
name: begin_sequence_from_table
description: Copies two config words into the node, counts the table entries up to the end marker, and halves the count unless the mode flag is set. It then starts the sequence with a routine call.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:6A68
name: begin_pair_sequence_from_index
description: Counts the entries of an indexed table up to the end marker and stores the count halved or unchanged depending on the mode flag. It then fetches the first entry and calls a routine with its offsets.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:6A82
name: advance_pair_sequence_step
description: Calls a routine with the current entry's offsets, increments the step count, and calls a second routine with the stored count. If the count has not reached the total, it stores the advanced pointer.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:6B0A
name: advance_sequence_with_status_flag
description: Calls two routines with the node's coordinates and the current step, increments the step count, and sets a status word to 1. It stores the advanced pointer unless the step count has reached the total.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:6BA6
name: store_pointer_and_return_zero
description: Stores a pointer into the destination cell and returns zero.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:6BB0
name: step_table_entry_until_end
description: When its status byte is zero, it sets the status and either draws the first table entry or runs the current entry through three routines, then advances the pointer. It returns 1 at the end marker and 0 otherwise, and when the status byte is nonzero it decrements it and returns 0.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:6BD0
name: begin_or_step_table_entry
description: Clears a status byte, then loads the table start when the pointer is null, or else runs the current entry through three routines and advances the pointer.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:6C30
name: advance_entry_and_report_end
description: Runs the current entry through two routines and sets a status word to 1. It stores the advanced pointer and returns true once the end marker is reached.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:6C90
name: store_pointer_and_return_zero
description: Stores a pointer into the destination cell and returns zero.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:71CC
name: read_command_bytes_until_end
description: Reads a byte stream in which values above 127 are commands. Each command calls a routine with a table entry and the byte value minus 64, and the stream ends at the sentinel value -1.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:71E8
name: read_command_stream_for_node
description: Reads commands from a node's stream the same way as its neighbouring reader: values above 127 call a routine with a table entry and offset value, and the next plain byte is stored in a node cell.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:7246
name: read_next_stream_byte
description: Reads the next byte from a stream pointer into a cell, or clears the cell when the sentinel -1 is reached. It returns 1.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:725A
name: read_stream_byte_unchecked
description: Reads the next byte from a stream pointer into a cell without checking for the sentinel, and returns 1.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:7268
name: clear_cell_return_one
description: Clears a cell and returns 1.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:7272
name: draw_cell_with_optional_offset
description: If the record's flag is set, it substitutes an offset position for the one supplied. It then looks up an entry in a table for the computed index, and calls a routine to draw the cell at the computed coordinates when that entry is nonzero.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:72DA
name: draw_two_cell_positions
description: Computes a cell index for two positions, checks a table entry for each, and calls the drawing routine with the matching graphic entries. A third cell is drawn at an offset from the first.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:7604
name: test_cell_bit_and_call
description: Computes a cell index from a packed position and passes that cell's table value, masked to one bit, together with the index to a routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:7660
name: store_cell_code_and_refresh
description: Derives a 3-bit code from the type argument and a position bit, packs it with the other fields into a per-cell table entry, and stores a second byte alongside it. It then calls a routine with the matching table value.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:774E
name: clear_area_and_init_state
description: Zeroes a block of 512 longwords, reads a value through a library call and stores it in a state cell. It then derives two words from global variables and an offset and writes them into state cells.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:77D2
name: check_flag_and_store
description: When the condition flag is set, it calls three routines and returns the result of a fourth shifted right by one. Otherwise it stores the returned value and a second word into a table indexed by a register.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:77FC
name: accumulate_delta_when_flag_set
description: If the low bit of the flag argument is set and the two positions match, it adds the difference between them to a running counter and calls a routine. Otherwise it returns its inputs unchanged.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:783E
name: assemble_byte_from_bits
description: Builds an 8-bit value by shifting left eight times and setting the low bit from the zero flag of each step. A routine is called on every pass.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:7852
name: build_huffman_decode_table
description: Reads 256 pairs of code length and value words and fills a local decoding table by placing each value at every table slot that matches its code length. Longer codes are handled by a separate branch.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:7922
name: stub_empty_return
description: The body is a bare return with no work, so calling it has no effect. It is a no-op stub.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:7A3A
name: read_word_with_counter_update
description: If the count argument is nonzero it returns the word at the input pointer. Otherwise it adds 512 to a running counter, calls a routine, and returns the word at the stored pointer.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:7A4C
name: decode_bits_with_count_limit
description: Decrements its count argument into a state word, then decodes a bit-coded value from the stream using the same mask search as its neighbouring routine. The result is returned with the updated pointer.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:7A94
name: decode_bits_from_bit_stream
description: Finds the highest set bit in a mask to get a code length, then reads that many bits from a bit stream held in state words. It advances the stream pointer when the bit buffer runs out and returns the decoded value.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:7BD8
name: load_stream_word_shifted
description: Clears a status word, then reads the next byte or aligned word from a stream pointer into a state word. The stored mask is shifted by the count argument before a routine is called.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:7C1A
name: adjust_counter_by_pointer_gap
description: Computes the gap between two stored pointers, offset by 512 and minus an argument, adds that value to a running counter, and calls a routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:7C34
name: init_memory_area_and_reset
description: Calls a library routine with a buffer and the value 67108864, runs three setup routines, and clears a status word.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:7C5A
name: dispatch_on_state_value
description: Calls one routine first, then picks a second routine from a state word: zero, one, or any other value reduced by two. The chosen routine's result is returned.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:7C8C
name: set_flags_and_run_setup
description: Calls two routines, sets two status words to 1, and makes a library call. It runs two extra routines unless the mode flag is set, then calls a final routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:7CCE
name: insert_entry_at_table_front
description: Shifts a table of 8-byte entries up by one slot, resets the entry count to -1, and writes two saved values into the first slot and a second pair of cells.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:7D3C
name: remove_entry_from_table_front
description: Decrements the entry count, shifts the remaining 8-byte table entries down by one slot, and writes two saved values into the first slot.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:7D96
name: reset_state_and_clear_area
description: Clears several state words and sets one timing word to 200 or 0 depending on a flag. It also calls two routines and clears a memory area through a library call using the value 188743680.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:7E28
name: run_eight_by_four_loop
description: Calls one routine, then runs four routine calls in each of eight loop passes, followed by one final call. It finishes by clearing a counter and setting another to 1.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:7EBA
name: reset_index_and_copy_pair
description: Sets a counter word to minus one and copies a two-longword value from one state cell into another.

description: Sets a flag to 1, calls a routine once for each value from 2 to 5 with that value stored in a state byte, then clears the flag.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:A7C8
name: collect_candidate_entries_for_source
description: Stores the source entry's value in a state byte and scans neighbouring positions around a stored offset for matching entries. It calls routines to record each candidate.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:A9A2
name: dispatch_entry_kind_check
description: Looks up an entry's kind code and switches on it. Kinds 1 through 6 each run their own scan that accumulates a result, and the accumulated value is returned.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:ABBE
name: collect_flagged_entries_for_group
description: Clears two counters, then walks the current group of entries, calling a routine for each entry with a nonzero flag and storing its position. It then sets a state word to 1.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:AE1C
name: pop_saved_pair_or_default
description: Returns the next saved pair from a list while entries remain. Once the list is exhausted it loads a default pair instead.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:AE58
name: extract_lowest_bit
description: Returns the least significant bit of the lower 16 bits of its 32-bit argument, as a 16-bit value.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:AE68
name: search_positions_with_local_tables
description: Runs a large routine that builds local tables on the stack and iterates over the grid, calling five routines to evaluate positions. It returns a computed value.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:BC08
name: count_set_bits_in_word
description: Iterates through the bits of a 16-bit parameter, shifting right until it is zero. It calls a helper routine for each bit and increments a counter when the helper returns a nonzero value, then returns the count.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:BC36
name: combine_three_values_weighted
description: Calls a routine three times and returns the negated weighted sum of the results, with weights 40, 20 and 8 for the third, second and first values.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:BCC4
name: lookup_offset_table_sum
description: Computes an offset from three indices, scaling the first by 240, the second by 2 and the third by 1440. It returns the sum of a table word and a state word at that offset.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:BD0A
name: update_bitmask_row_and_call
description: Inverts a mask word and clears its bits from a row word in a 16-bit bitmask table, then merges a second word into the next row. It calls a routine and returns its result.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:BDE6
name: combine_bitmask_rows
description: Copies a mask word from a table, merges it into a row word indexed by the first argument, then updates a second row using the inverted mask from the second argument. It returns the routine result.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:BF2C
name: compute_signed_difference_result
description: Computes a value from two routine results and stored values, branching on the second argument's byte and on the ordering of the first argument's fields. It stores the result and returns a short value.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:C198
name: initialize_search_state
description: Copies a side value into a state byte, sets a busy flag and calls a library routine, then clears several state words, negates two offsets and calls ten routines to set up the state.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:C300
name: check_counter_and_side_flag
description: Returns zero when a flag word is clear. Otherwise it calls a routine and returns zero if a counter is below a threshold while a per-side state matches 1, and 1 otherwise.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:C33A
name: init_entry_grid_and_ranges
description: Fills a 24-row by 2-column block of 8-byte entries with a sentinel pair, sets two index cells to -1, then loops over stored row ranges to fill further cells.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:C41C
name: call_and_store_when_unflagged
description: Sets a status word from a flag byte and calls a routine with its argument. When a related counter is zero, it stores the returned value in a cell.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:C46E
name: inspect_undecoded_scan_routine
description: The decompiler timed out, so the logic is unknown. The routine has 122 instructions, calls four other routines, and has two callers.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:C604
name: process_queued_entry_or_scan
description: If a flag in the current record is set, it copies the current entry into a queue slot, clears a status word and calls a routine, returning early when that routine succeeds. The rest of the routine scans further table entries.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:C91A
name: append_entry_and_update_record
description: Appends the current state pair to a record list while it holds fewer than 23 entries. It then updates a per-record flag and calls routines depending on the stored counts.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:CC4A
name: check_and_store_matching_entry
description: When the second argument's flag byte is set and the current entry does not match the argument, it calls routines to test two stored flags. If the tests allow it, it stores the argument in the next record slot.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:CD30
name: test_record_entries_for_success
description: When a record field is nonzero, it calls a routine on the current entry and returns 1 if that succeeds. Otherwise it loops over the stored entries, calling the routine on each until one succeeds.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:CDEC
name: update_max_if_in_range
description: Returns 1 when the argument is at most the first stored value, raising a second stored maximum to the argument when it is larger. Otherwise it returns zero.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:CE26
name: advance_record_and_evaluate_entries
description: Sets a record count from its length field and, when a mode word equals 5, calls routines to process the current entry and a table lookup. It updates the record's counters when a result is zero and continues with a longer evaluation.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:D28E
name: classify_and_accumulate_metric
description: When the step counter equals 1, it reads two values and classifies them into one of four ranges. It then adds a quarter of a stored value times that class into two record fields, and returns 1 when the second value exceeds 2.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:D374
name: copy_entry_into_record
description: Calls a routine with the record pointer and a sub-block, copies the current table entry into the record's list slot, and at step zero saves a stored value. It replaces that value with a constant when the mode word equals 5.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:D3E4
name: try_values_two_to_five
description: Sets a candidate flag, then calls a routine with each value from 2 to 5 stored in a state byte, returning 1 as soon as a call succeeds. If none succeeds it clears the flag and returns 0.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:D45A
name: initialize_record_from_entry_neighbours
description: Fills a new record slot from an entry's kind and value, then scans adjacent table positions for a matching entry of the same kind and sets record fields when one matches. Further checks call routines.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:D6D2
name: initialize_record_by_kind
description: Stores the argument's value and kind into a new record slot and clears its flags. It then switches on the kind byte to set kind-specific fields in the record.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:DAF2
name: walk_pattern_table_for_record
description: Marks a new record as active, then steps through a pattern table of coordinate pairs, storing each pair in the record and calling routines for matching entries.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:DBE6
name: promote_record_on_threshold
description: When the previous record has kind 6 and a routine returns a value above 31, it marks the new record active with kind 6 and stores a position derived from the previous record.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:DD7E
name: replay_records_in_reverse
description: Saves the current record count, then walks the record list backward, swapping two saved index words and calling a routine with each record's pair. It calls a routine for the final entry when a flag is set.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:DDFE
name: replay_records_forward
description: Calls a routine for the flagged record when a flag is set, then walks the records forward, calling a routine on each and swapping two saved index words.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:DE7A
name: report_wrong_claim_result
description: Calls routines to update state and reads a result word. When a status word is set and a flag is clear, it shows the message Jay was wrong #1 from a fixed text entry; otherwise it clears the status word.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:E084
name: evaluate_packed_move_parameters
description: Runs a very large evaluation of a move from bit-packed parameters, checks flags for the current side, and calls routines to report or store the outcome. It returns a computed value.
